mechanics.claim: Sejuani dashes until she collides with an enemy champion, dealing damage to enemies passed through along the way.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through

mechanics.claim: Q can be cast during other abilities without interrupting them, and vice versa.
mechanics.quote: Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.

mechanics.claim: If the dash collides with an enemy champion, Sejuani is ordered to basic attack them, which can reset the attack timer.
mechanics.quote: If the dash collides with an enemy champion, '''Sejuani''' will be ordered to basic attack them.
